primary_upstream_sources.paraphrase: Linux statistics include kernel-accepted packets not yet read by the application; libpcap accumulates statistics across reads.
Interrupt cleanup uses breakloop; live statistics report callback count and libpcap counters, with requests deferred during callbacks.

limits: Upstream tags explain API behavior; distro patches are not asserted byte-identical. Installed behavior is tested in the owned fixture. This does not identify the historical two-record cause.
